title: Dishonour of cheque for insufficiency of funds
textContent: [NI Act s.138] Makes dishonour of a cheque drawn for discharge of a debt/liability, for insufficiency of funds, a criminal offence — subject to the three provisos: cheque presented within its validity period, statutory demand notice served within 30 days of dishonour, and the drawer's failure to pay within 15 days of receipt of that notice. Working summary — verify exact statutory text against India Code before citing in a filed document.

title: Cognizance of offences — limitation and complaint procedure
textContent: [NI Act s.142] Complaint under s.138 must be filed by the payee/holder in due course, in writing, within one month of the date on which the cause of action arises under proviso (c) to s.138 (i.e., expiry of the 15-day payment window) — extendable by the court on shown sufficient cause.
